meta.title: Crossed-out eye marks a stage not yet reviewed
gaps: The visual presence and clearing of the crossed-out eye icon next to the Technical Stage tab.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The visual presence and clearing of the crossed-out eye icon next to the Technical Stage tab.

steps.note: Open a new multi-stage project creation screen.
Add the Technical Stage and RFQ stage without opening the Technical Stage.
Review the RFQ stage so the Technical Stage remains unvisited.
Assert the UI marks the unvisited Technical Stage as not reviewed.
Open the Technical Stage to review it.
Assert the not-reviewed state clears after the Technical Stage is opened.
